As of 17 October, 2023, Sam reaches out to Evan, expressing that he has been missing their chats and shares that he had a health scare the previous weekend, ending up in the ER with a severe stomachache. Sam reveals that he was diagnosed with gastritis, which served as an alarming wake-up call for him to start prioritizing his health by adopting a more nutritious diet and getting regular exercise. He also mentions that his phone has been giving him a hard time, adding to his stress. Evan expresses sympathy for Sam's situation, acknowledging that gastritis is tough and emphasizing the importance of taking care of oneself. He shares that he has been focusing on fitness, which has been beneficial for his overall well-being, and mentions that he recently had another encounter with a lost tourist, humorously noting that helping tourists has become a recurring theme in his life. Sam thanks Evan for his support and expresses a desire to get into fitness, asking for tips on staying motivated.
